summary: Iteration 4 backend-only retest for the new _install_windows_asyncio_filter hook. Added test_windows_asyncio_filter.py (4 tests) covering: (a) GET /api/config still returns full expected shape after startup hook runs; (b) the asyncio logging.Filter drops synthetic 'ConnectionResetError ... 10054' and '_ProactorBasePipeTransport._call_connection_lost' records while an unrelated asyncio.warning still passes through (proves asyncio logging is NOT globally silenced); (c) the loop.set_exception_handler swallows ConnectionResetError, ConnectionAbortedError, and the proactor message-only case, while forwarding any other exception to the default handler; (d) 10 rapid open/close cycles on demo::0 leave no orphan streamer (fps=0, still 6 sources present). All 14 prior tests (test_multiview_perf.py + test_disconnect_cleanup.py) remain green. Final result: 18/18 passed in 82s with -n 0.
critical_code_review_comments: _install_windows_asyncio_filter is defensive and correctly scoped: exception_handler only shortcircuits on ConnectionResetError/ConnectionAbortedError or the exact proactor message; everything else falls through to loop.default_exception_handler. Verified in test.

The _ConnResetFilter is attached ONLY to the 'asyncio' logger (not root) and matches on both 'ConnectionResetError'+'10054' and the proactor callback string — narrow enough that unrelated asyncio warnings still emit. Verified.
Minor: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; consider migrating to lifespan handlers when convenient (not blocking).

Minor: asyncio.get_event_loop() inside the hook is fine because it runs from the startup coroutine (loop is running), but on Python 3.12+ this API will keep working only inside a running loop — current call site is safe.
seed_data_creation: None persistent (TEST_ layout created and deleted in CRUD test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Windows-specific ConnectionResetError from ProactorEventLoop cannot be reproduced on this Linux container; verification is done via in-process unit test of _install_windows_asyncio_filter plus regression of iteration_3's 14 tests. Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v -n 0 (tests share global streamer state; ~82s runtime). Base URL from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
